steps.t: Find the PO number
steps.d: The Requisitioner or Central Receiver starts the GR posting with transaction MIGO in SAP; for Coupa purchase orders the receipt is completed directly in Coupa.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-01.01.01

steps.t: Verify the quantity received
steps.d: For each line item the receiver checks that the quantity received is correct and ticks OK.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-01.01.02

steps.q: Enough quantity left on the PO?
steps.d: The receiver confirms there is enough open quantity on the PO to receive the delivered goods or services.
steps.ex: Delivery of 120 units against a PO with 100 units open
steps.yes: Continue to step 3 - post the receipt
steps.no: PO modification: the PO is amended first (process 1.2.3.2 Modify Purchase Order)
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-01.01.02 flow

steps.t: Post the receipt - GR nudge and pre-filled receipt
steps.d: The receiver uses Check to confirm the posting is possible for the amount, then posts the receipt.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-01.01.03
pp: Delays in posting goods receipts hurt Payment to Terms and Invoice Turnaround Time
steps.rec: Celonis / Coupa flags invoices waiting in Pending receipt and nudges the requisitioner automatically (Teams / email, escalating by ageing to the line manager). The receipt is pre-filled from the PO line and the delivery note so the receiver only confirms the quantity.
steps.tools: Celonis action flow or Coupa notification; Power Automate / Teams; delivery-note OCR (Kofax)
steps.feasc: Automated reminder emails for pending receipts are already in place; pre-filling or performing the receipt is not - the requester must still confirm the physical receipt (control). Under exploration by the global P2P team.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: Verify the GR posting
steps.d: The receiver checks that the GR box is ticked on the PO (ME23N Display PO) or verifies the GR quantity and amount in Coupa.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-01.01.04
steps.ctl: GR check in SAP / Coupa before invoice matching

opp.t: GR ageing monitor and nudge agent
opp.d: Monitor POs with invoices waiting in Pending receipt, nudge the requisitioner and escalate by ageing; report GR lead time by market against the P2P KPIs (Payment to Terms, Invoice TAT).
opp.feasc: The GR reminder is already in place (Coupa notifications, email reminders, team script); the global P2P team is exploring the receipt-related AI use cases.

procs.name: Flow 1 - Invoice received and captured (Kofax / electronic channel)
procs.owner: Supplier / Requestor; AP Scanning team; Kofax / Bottomline
inbox: Supplier submits an invoice or credit note after goods or services are delivered
procs.outnote: Electronic invoices land in Coupa directly; paper and PDF invoices come through the CIR mailbox and OCR

steps.t: Invoice raised and submitted
steps.d: The supplier submits the invoice through the agreed channel: electronically via CSP or iPay, or as a PDF / paper invoice to the requestor or the CIR mailbox.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-02.01.01

steps.d: Electronic invoices are created in Coupa directly. Paper and PDF invoices go through the CIR mailbox and OCR (Kofax or Bottomline).
steps.ex: A CSP invoice lands in Coupa; a PDF emailed to the requestor goes to the CIR mailbox
steps.yes: Electronic (CSP / iPay) - the invoice is created directly in Coupa; nothing to export - straight to the output
steps.no: Paper / PDF: route to the CIR mailbox for scanning (step 2)
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-02.01.01 flow; P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

nx.nl: Electronic - invoice created directly in Coupa

steps.t: Route to the CIR mailbox / scan paper invoice
steps.d: The requestor validates the invoice, adds accounting codes and budget-holder details and sends it to the CIR mailbox; paper invoices are scanned by the Scanning team. AP monitors the CIR spam mailbox so no invoice is lost.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.01.02-03, P2P-02.03.01
steps.rec: An AI mailbox triage reads the CIR mailbox: it separates invoices from other mail, lifts the accounting codes and budget-holder details the requestor supplied, and bounces invalid file types / sizes back to the sender automatically, so step 2a disappears for most cases.
steps.tools: LLM email classifier (Azure OpenAI / Copilot Studio); Power Automate; Kofax import connector
steps.feasc: Already part of the design: invoices sent to the CIR mailbox are captured by the system and generated as invoice documents into Kofax.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.d: Kofax / Bottomline accept the file only if the type and size are valid; discarded emails go back to the sender and the AP generic mailbox.
steps.ex: A .zip attachment or an oversized scan is discarded
steps.yes: Continue to OCR extraction (step 3)
steps.no: Step 2a - notify the supplier to resend with the correct file type / size, then re-check
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.03.01-04

fix.d: AP notifies the supplier or requestor to resend the invoice with the correct file type / size; the resent invoice is checked again.
fix.rec: Auto-reply with the accepted formats and size limit; AP only sees repeat failures.
fix.feasc: Kofax may support automated notifications, but AP still manages the discarded emails; supplier details and the current configuration need to be validated.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: Kofax OCR extracts and validates the invoice
steps.d: Kofax prepares and separates the documents, captures the invoice details by OCR and validates them with its algorithms and machine-learning rules.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.02.01-04
pp: Unstructured data makes Kofax line-item matching difficult
steps.rec: Add an LLM extraction layer for unstructured invoices: line-item descriptions are matched to PO lines by meaning rather than exact text, and low-confidence fields are routed to AP (step 4) instead of failing the match.
steps.tools: Kofax + LLM document extraction (Azure Document Intelligence / GPT); Coupa PO line data
steps.feasc: OCR extraction is in place; the LLM layer to match line items by meaning (low-confidence cases routed to AP) is the new part - to be explored.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: AP verifies and completes the extracted data
steps.d: The AP team verifies the accuracy of the extracted data, completes missing details, requests clarification where needed and rejects invalid invoices; verified invoices are exported to Coupa.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.02.05-06, P2P-02.01.04
steps.ctl: BAU monitoring that verified invoices transmit from Kofax to Coupa
steps.rec: AP reviews only the fields below the confidence threshold; high-confidence invoices pass straight to Coupa. Kofax-to-Coupa transmission is monitored on a dashboard rather than by a daily manual check.
steps.tools: Kofax confidence scores; Celonis / Power BI transmission monitor
steps.feasc: Confidence-based review (e.g. 80% threshold for straight-through) can be explored; the transmission monitoring belongs after the export, and the Celonis dashboard already exists.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

cop.d: Copilot drafts the query to the supplier or requester for the fields that could not be extracted, from the invoice image and the PO.

steps.t: Ready to export to Coupa
steps.d: The verified invoice is ready to be exported to Coupa (Draft queue for OCR / manual invoices), where the AP team reviews it.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.01.05, P2P-02.03.05

steps.q: Invoice arrived in Coupa (no integration error)?
steps.d: AP reconciles with the Celonis 'Coupa Integration Error' report, the SAP vs Bottomline count and the scanning mailbox 'Undelivered' folder.
steps.ex: An invoice counted in Bottomline is missing from Coupa
steps.yes: Continue to the output - invoice available for processing
steps.no: Step 5a - raise a ServiceNow ticket for the Kofax-Coupa integration failure; once resolved the invoice returns to step 5
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.03.06-13

fix.t: Raise a ServiceNow ticket and resolve
fix.d: AP raises an incident ticket via ServiceNow for Kofax-Coupa integration failures (or forwards the original email to the scanning mailbox); once resolved the invoice goes back to step 5 (Ready to export to Coupa).
fix.rec: Interface monitoring detects Kofax-Coupa failures and raises the ServiceNow incident with the invoice reference automatically; AP tracks the resolution.
fix.feasc: A ServiceNow ticket is raised only after the team validates that the integration failure is technical; automatic ticket creation is not relevant. Transmission monitoring (Celonis dashboard) is already implemented.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

opp.d: LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of Kofax with confidence-based routing; target: most PDF and email invoices reach Coupa with no AP touch.
opp.feasc: LLM extraction and semantic matching on top of the existing OCR - to be explored; Kofax itself is being replaced by a new global tool.

procs.name: Flow 2 - PO + GR + invoice match in Coupa
procs.owner: Coupa, with AP and the Requestor on exceptions
procs.outnote: Auto-approved when the PO, receipt and invoice match within tolerance; otherwise approved by the business (Flow 3)

steps.t: Invoice arrives in Coupa
steps.d: The captured invoice is created in Coupa and Coupa checks it is complete: mandatory information present, supplier not flagged for review, remit-to address known, billing information valid.

steps.q: Invoice complete and ready to match?
steps.d: Invoices that are incomplete, from a supplier flagged for AP review, with a new remit-to address or with invalid billing information wait in a Coupa exception status (Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold, Pending Action) until AP or the requestor actions them.
steps.ex: A CSP invoice with a new remit-to address waits in Booking Hold until AP maps the address
steps.yes: Continue to step 2 - match
steps.no: Exception 1a - AP or the requestor completes the information or releases the hold, then the invoice is checked again

fix.d: Draft: AP completes the missing invoice details. AP Hold: AP reviews and releases the hold (or disputes). Booking Hold: AP maps the supplier remit-to address and releases. Pending Action: the requestor enters the billing string (or the split accounting template) and resubmits.
fix.rec: An agent completes missing invoice details from the PO, supplier record and remit-to master, maps the remit-to address and proposes the hold release; AP approves the proposal instead of keying the data.
fix.tools: Coupa API; vendor master (DMT); LLM agent
fix.feasc: Covered by the global non-PO project that just went live.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: Coupa matches PO, goods receipt and invoice
steps.d: Coupa reads the match type on the supplier record and matches the invoice to the purchase order (2-way) and to the goods receipt (3-way): the invoice is only accepted for what was ordered and received.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.06.01-02, 04

steps.d: For a 3-way match Coupa checks that a receipt exists for the invoice; if not, the invoice waits in Pending Receipt.
steps.ex: Services delivered but the requestor has not confirmed receipt
steps.yes: Continue to the tolerance check
steps.no: Exception 2a - the requestor confirms the goods receipt, then the match runs again
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.06.02, P2P-02.08.01

fix.d: The requestor receives a notification to create the goods receipt in Coupa for goods physically received or services delivered; AP follows up with the supplier or requestor if the invoice needs to be disputed.
pp: GR delays leave invoices stuck in Pending receipt
fix.rec: Automated GR chaser: the requestor is reminded on a schedule with the PO and invoice attached and escalated by ageing; AP steps in only when the chaser fails.
fix.tools: Coupa notifications; Power Automate / Teams; Celonis ageing
fix.feasc: Coupa notifications and the team script already chase missing receipts; the global P2P receipt initiative covers the rest.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.d: Coupa checks the invoice against the PO tolerance; invoices outside tolerance go On Hold for AP review.
steps.ex: Invoice price 5% above the PO price
steps.yes: Auto-approved - continue to step 3
steps.no: Exception 2b - AP reviews the variance: accepts and routes for business approval, or disputes
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.06.02, 04, P2P-02.09.01-02

fix.d: AP reviews the difference between the invoice and the PO; if accepted the invoice is submitted for business approval (Flow 3), otherwise it is disputed back to the supplier.
fix.rec: A variance assistant explains the difference (price list, contract, FX, quantity) and auto-accepts variances within policy; AP decides only the residual cases.
fix.tools: Coupa; contract / price-list data; LLM assistant
fix.feasc: Coupa standard: price variances within the approved threshold are auto-approved and the variance assistant already states whether the PO unit price or the total is off.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: Invoice Approval
steps.d: Invoices that match within tolerance are approved automatically; invoices with a variance are approved or rejected by the business approver in Coupa (Flow 3).
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.06.03, P2P-02.08.02

opp.d: One agent works the Draft, AP Hold, Booking Hold and Pending receipt queues: proposes the fix, chases the right person and releases within policy; AP supervises by exception.
opp.feasc: Covered by the global non-PO project (just live), the existing Coupa notifications and the Coupa variance threshold.

procs.name: Flow 3 - Approval and SAP posting
inbox: Invoice needing business approval (variation to the PO), or approved invoice ready to post
procs.outdoc: Invoice posted in SAP, ready for payment
procs.outnote: SAP document number and projected payment date are sent back to Coupa

steps.t: Approver reviews the invoice in Coupa
steps.d: The approver receives a to-do on the Coupa home screen and reviews the invoice or credit note that varies from the PO.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.11.01-02
pp: Tolerance inconsistency Coupa vs SAP Direct Materials
steps.rec: The approver receives a one-paragraph variance summary (what differs from the PO, why, policy position) with a recommended action. Harmonise the over-delivery tolerance between Coupa and SAP Direct Materials so the same invoice is not blocked twice.
steps.tools: Coupa approval to-do + LLM summary; tolerance master alignment (Coupa / SAP)
steps.feasc: Nice to have, low impact. The Coupa / SAP over-delivery tolerance difference is a known S/4 issue, not a separate AI solution.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

cop.d: Copilot summarises what differs from the PO and the policy position for the approver, instead of a one-paragraph summary built into Coupa.

steps.d: The approver approves the invoice / credit note or rejects it with comments; rejected invoices are disputed back to the supplier with a dispute reason.
steps.ex: Quantity invoiced exceeds the delivery - rejected
steps.yes: Continue to step 2 - export to SAP
steps.no: Reject with comments - dispute sent to the supplier (process 2.1.3.1); resubmitted once resolved
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.11.03, 05, P2P-02.19.01-06

steps.t: Invoice exported to SAP
steps.d: Once fully approved the invoice is exported to SAP for payment; Coupa checks the approval and the Exported flag before sending.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.11.04, P2P-02.20.01-04

steps.d: SAP returns the document number, or an error message that is visible in the Coupa integration history and the SAP posting error field.
steps.ex: Posting fails on a blocked vendor or a missing WHT code
steps.yes: Continue to step 3
steps.no: Step 2a - AP resolves the error by error type (IT ticket if needed), sets Exported = No and re-pushes, or posts manually in SAP
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.20.05, 07-13

fix.d: AP follows the resolution steps by error type (ServiceNow ticket if IT support is required), marks Exported = No so the invoice is re-pushed to SAP, or posts the invoice manually in SAP and asks Ops IT to update the SAP reference in Coupa.
fix.rec: Posting errors are classified by type; known types (missing WHT code, blocked vendor, closed period) trigger the fix request to DMT / Ops IT and the re-push (Exported = No) automatically. AP handles only unknown errors.
fix.tools: Coupa-SAP error log; rules + LLM classifier; ServiceNow API
fix.feasc: SAP already shows the posting error message; the remaining effort is AP investigation of the message - part of the existing design.
fix.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.t: Posted in SAP - liability recorded; document number back to Coupa
steps.d: SAP returns the document number and projected payment date to Coupa; once paid, the payment information is sent back and the invoice is marked paid.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.20.05-06
out: Posted invoice for the payment run

opp.d: Classify Coupa-to-SAP posting errors, auto-apply the known fix and re-push, and feed error patterns back to DMT master-data quality.
opp.feasc: SAP posting error messages are part of the existing design; AP investigates from the message.

frames.lead: Invoices arrive electronically or through the CIR mailbox and Kofax OCR, are matched to the PO and receipt in Coupa, approved by the business where they vary from the PO and posted to SAP.

frames.name: Payment
frames.win: Per payment run · Automated run, manual exceptions · SAP (F110), bank
frames.owner: P2P Accounts Payable with O2C Cash & Banking
ctl: Scheduled payment run on due date; payment confirmation / ACK file from Cash & Banking
AP Payment Lead / AP management approval of manual and emergency payments
Early payment approval matrix in ServiceNow
Xelix duplicate payment monitoring before the payment run

ch.t: Incoming funds cannot always be traced to the relevant supplier, so they are hard to post to the right P&L or vendor account
The early payment approval matrix is maintained manually in ServiceNow and is not always up to date, causing wrong routing and back-and-forth with the market or requestor
Xelix covers down payments, but some high-risk scenarios are not flagged (e.g. an invoice posted before the down payment); these cases are under review
ch.ref: Flow 6 · step 2 (row P2P-03.09.02) - reworded per the P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

up.w: Posted invoices and down payments for the payment run
Rejected payments, direct debits, incoming funds notifications
Early payment and payment date change requests (ServiceNow)

down.w: Payment (or rejection notice / request to resubmit)

pp: Untraceable incoming funds
Early payment approval matrix maintained manually in ServiceNow
Xelix cannot detect duplicate down payments

procs.name: Flow 1 - Standard payment run (normal flow)
procs.owner: SAP payment run; Cash & Banking; AP
inbox: Invoice posted in SAP with its payment terms
procs.outnote: The normal journey for the large majority of invoices - no manual step

steps.t: Invoice posted in SAP with a due date
steps.d: The posted invoice carries the supplier's payment terms, so SAP knows when it falls due.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-02.20.05, P2P-03.06.05 (payment run picks up invoices by due date)

steps.t: Payment run executed; payment file to the bank
steps.d: The regular payment run is executed as scheduled and the payment file goes to the bank through Cash & Banking.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.01, P2P-03.02.01

steps.d: Items that fail in the run or are rejected by the bank are handled as exceptions: rejected payments (Flow 3) or a manual / emergency payment (Flow 2).
steps.ex: Invalid bank key - the item fails and is reworked
steps.yes: Continue to step 3 - supplier paid
steps.no: Exception: payment failure - see Flow 2 (manual payment) and Flow 3 (rejected payments)
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.02, P2P-03.07.01, P2P-03.08.01

steps.t: Supplier paid; bank confirmation received
steps.d: The bank executes the payment; Cash & Banking receives the confirmation / ACK file as evidence.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-03.01.11
steps.ctl: Payment confirmation and ACK file as evidence

steps.t: Vendor open item cleared
steps.d: After the F110 execution the vendor open item is cleared automatically in SAP; the payment information is sent back to Coupa and the invoice marked paid.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.14, P2P-02.20.06

procs.name: Flow 2 - Exception: manual and emergency payments
procs.owner: Cash & Banking; AP Payment Processor; AP management
inbox: Scheduled payment run (F110) is executed and an item fails
procs.outdoc: Manual payment executed by Cash & Banking; vendor open item cleared
procs.outnote: Approved manual payments are raised via CROWN and executed by Cash & Banking. If manual payment is not required or AP approval is declined, return to the same Re-run the payment run node.

steps.t: Payment run executed; failure identified
steps.d: The regular payment run is executed as scheduled; failures (system issues, invalid characters, technical reasons) are identified by Cash & Banking and the invoice details sent to AP.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.01-02, P2P-03.02.01-03

steps.t: Investigate and assess the resolution
steps.d: Cash & Banking investigates the root cause (engaging IT or P2P where needed); AP validates the invoice record and the nature of the error and assesses whether a re-run or a manual payment is required.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.03-04, P2P-03.02.04
steps.rec: A failure root-cause classifier (invalid characters, bank details, format, system) proposes whether a re-run or a manual payment is needed.
steps.tools: SAP F110 log; rules / ML classifier
steps.feasc: Payment-failure handling is covered by the Cash & Banking PSPC initiative; SAP shows the high-level failure and AP / Cash & Banking judge re-run vs manual payment. Ownership to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

cop.d: Copilot drafts the investigation note from the SAP failure message and the vendor master, for AP and Cash & Banking to decide on re-run vs manual payment.

steps.d: If the issue can be resolved by re-running the payment process, no manual payment is needed; otherwise the payment document is reversed for manual processing.
steps.ex: Invalid characters in the bank key - re-run after correction
steps.yes: Continue to step 3 - reverse the ZP document and raise the request
steps.no: Re-run the payment process
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), row P2P-03.01.04

steps.t: Reverse the payment document and raise the manual payment request
steps.d: Cash & Banking reverses the ZP document; the P2P Payment Processor prepares and submits the manual payment request with payment details, supporting documents, root cause and approvals (via CROWN).
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.05-06, P2P-03.02.05
steps.rec: The manual payment request in CROWN is pre-filled from the SAP document (payment details, supporting documents, root cause) for the Payment Processor to confirm.
steps.tools: CROWN; SAP; Power Automate
steps.feasc: CROWN is being replaced by Cash & Banking; the pre-filled request depends on the new tool.
steps.feasl: Feasibility - P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau)

steps.q: Approved by the AP Payment Lead / AP management?
steps.d: AP management validates the request and decides whether to approve the manual payment. If not approved, return directly to the existing Re-run the payment run node.
steps.ex: Supporting documents incomplete - rejected
steps.yes: Continue to step 4 - instruction to Cash & Banking
steps.no: Return directly to Re-run the payment run (same node as the No branch of D1)
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.06-07, P2P-03.02.06-09; P2P final review 16 Oct 2026 (Ching Yee Thow, Emily Lau); R2R & P2P flows validation.docx

steps.t: Manual payment instruction to Cash & Banking
steps.d: The approved request with invoice, banking data and approvals is sent in one communication to Cash & Banking for execution; business users are informed only when the value date is affected.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.08-09, P2P-03.02.10-11

steps.t: Cash & Banking executes the payment and confirms
steps.d: Cash & Banking executes the manual payment (F110 or bank) and sends the confirmation, proof of payment, ACK file and the request to clear the vendor account.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.10-13, P2P-03.02.12-13
steps.ctl: Payment confirmation and ACK file as evidence

steps.t: Clear the vendor open item
steps.d: AP clears the vendor account (F-44); after an F110 execution the open item clears automatically.
steps.src: P2P process register (Oct 2026), rows P2P-03.01.14, P2P-03.02.14

opp.d: Classify payment-run failures, pre-fill the manual payment request and track the vendor clearing (F-44) so the exception closes without re-keying.
opp.feasc: Payment-failure handling sits with Cash & Banking (PSPC initiative) - to confirm with Cash & Banking / O2C.

procs.name: Flow 3 - Exception: rejected payments (before and after funds release)
inbox: A payment item is rejected by the system or by the bank
procs.outdoc: Invoice unblocked and paid in the next payment run
